identification: Tub of six framed or mounted botanical photographic works, all rose or petal subjects plus one shell still life: (1) single red/pink rose head seen from below, colour photograph in a timber frame; (2) large square box frame with a pale photo/collage of crumpled white rose petals on grey; (3) small colour photograph 'Shells' in a reeded red timber frame and cream mat, pencil-inscribed below the image 'Bashir Baraki [edition, reads like 1/5 or 95]  Shells  1996'; (4) unframed black board mounted with a grid of about 34 pink-and-yellow rose petal images (or real pressed petals, can't tell from photo); (5) small pale box frame with a petal photo/collage; (6) small red frame with a cream rose on a maroon ground with a tiny printed caption, unreadable. Estimate A$20-30.
